summary: Benewah County tower on Tyson Peak: 1934 camp, L-4 cab tower by 1939. Sources give 1957 for destruction, but a 1956 Geodetic Survey note says it was already removed. No source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association. Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed in 1957; a Geodetic Survey note quoted by Forest Lookouts says it was removed before its 1956 survey.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts calls it a hike-in. Forest Lookouts reproduces Geodetic Survey directions: a road that needs four-wheel drive past washouts, then a trail of about one mile to the top.

events.note: Geodetic Survey note: the tower had been removed before its 1956 survey; the year of removal is not given

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date destruction to 1957. Forest Lookouts quotes a Geodetic Survey note that the tower was removed before a 1956 survey. The story reports both and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Destruction year conflict (1957 vs removed before 1956) is the main open question. The Forest Lookouts directions come from a Geodetic Survey block and may be out of date, so the story presents them as what the page says. No photos found. The 1956 survey tablet is described in 1956 terms; no source says whether it is still there.
